newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates drop on bank liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates drop on bank liquidation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates fell at midday on Thursday as banks felt the pressure to liquidate excess reserves before the end of the current reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 6.250 percent against Wednesday's 6.346 percent close, with 30-day commercial paper at 6.10-6.15 percent against 6.30-6.35 percent.
Dealers said the rates would remain in a tight range in the absence of significant market-moving factors.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield stood at 6.0940 percent against 6.0975-6.1035. -- James Lin (5080815)
